name: Shox
summary:
Shox is an arcade racing game featuring licensed rally cars competing across offroad courses in three locations: Arctic Tundra, Arid Desert, and Asian Jungle. The single-player league mode consists of four progressively difficult leagues with six races each, requiring first-place average standings to advance.

The game introduces shox zones; three per race where players earn medals for speed. Achieving gold in all three zones triggers a challenging shock wave that players must follow for maximum rewards. Players earn money through race performance and shox zone achievements to purchase cars across four classes, while collisions incur fees. An additional betting mode allows head-to-head races against opponents for faster earnings.
